new_learnings.text: Macro regime shifts (Iran deal → oil crash) trigger clean sector rotation: resources/metals in freefall, defensives (banks, pharma) rallying. Portfolio should always hold 1-2 defensive positions when geopolitical tensions are elevated to avoid being 0% exposed to leadership on rotation days.
new_learnings.mechanism: Geopolitical de-escalation removes scarcity premium from commodities, triggering mean-reversion in resource sectors while capital rotates to yield/defensive plays. The cascade is fast (<48 hours) and comprehensive — portfolio construction must anticipate this.

new_learnings.text: Volume 8.8x MAVOL30 on -9% day is a reliable distribution signal. When combined with stop proximity <2% and sector in bottom 5, the sell decision is mechanical — no 'thesis still valid' exceptions. This pattern was also seen in 扬杰科技 03-03 gap-down.
new_learnings.mechanism: Extreme volume on large down days indicates institutional position liquidation, not retail panic. The volume-to-MAVOL30 ratio >5x is a threshold worth formalizing as a hard-sell trigger when combined with stop proximity.

new_learnings.text: The entry_regime hard block correctly prevented any new positions today when every candidate looked 'almost good enough.' V1's biggest mistake was forcing entries on weak tape. The automatic gate (breadth <1.5:1 + <2 indices green + f10>30) is working as designed.
new_learnings.mechanism: Weak breadth with red indices signals distribution, not accumulation. Even the best individual setups fail in this environment because sector rotation overrides stock-specific catalysts. Cash is a valid position.

new_learnings.text: Breadth divergence (2764 up vs indices deep red) is a warning signal, not a green light. Small-cap marginal gains cannot offset large-cap cyclical collapse. This pattern often precedes broader weakness.
new_learnings.mechanism: When small caps barely rise (r0_2=1602 of 2764 up stocks) while large caps crash, it suggests institutional rotation out of index heavyweights into small speculative positions — not healthy accumulation. The 'over 3300 stocks green' headline masks the real damage.
